title: macOS: quiet-room speaker-output attempt
scope: Actual production playback backing with native48k mono microphone observation under paced native Parakeet-v3 decoder load. Threshold-qualified arrival, not human perception or full-turn latency.
summary: 29/30 warm pickups qualified. No acoustic median or fastest-default decision accepted; all attempts and refusals remain retained.

environment.hardware: Apple M3 MacBook Air,16GB RAM,256GB storage
environment.workload: Paced cached native Parakeet-v3 authored English prefixes,400ms then1s updates; decoder load, not production mic/AEC/EOU integration. Owner confirmed other audio stopped before the quiet attempt.
environment.cold_warm: One separate first-after-prepare request; 30 completed varied warm requests, cycling five English phrases. No voice-quality inference.
environment.audio_route: Built-in speakers/microphone; native48000Hz mono float32. Source gain0.75. Hardware output38%,input51%,unmuted retained from setup; not audited at each trial boundary.

provenance.command: Tools/tts_compare.py --speaker-output --trials 30 --workload-ready <reference-ASR-ready-file>; Exact source, binary/probe pins and original attempts are linked in the report.
provenance.grader: Native host timestamps; two consecutive10ms windows above max(.001RMS,4x room baseline), >=.75 rendered/microphone envelope correlation, strict timestamps/callbacktokens/route/drop gates. No survivor-only acoustic medians.

metrics.name: Attempted warm microphone trials
metrics.boundary: Completed warm requests in the retained native report; admission refusals have zero.

metrics.name: Qualified warm microphone trials
metrics.boundary: Requests passing frozen clock/room/correlation/onset/route gates; not an engine quality score.

metrics.name: Warm first non-silent render
metrics.boundary: Text request → actual post-gain render timestamp

metrics.name: Warm estimated presentation
metrics.boundary: Render timestamp + queried output-node maximum presentation estimate; not observed sound.

metrics.name: First-after-preparation microphone pickup
metrics.boundary: First text request after preparation → qualified microphone pickup; not hardware-cold.

limitations: Incomplete five-model qualification prevents a fastest-audible default; owner confirmed a quiet room for this attempt.
Microphone pickup is threshold-dependent and includes acoustic/input timing; it is not human perceptual onset.
Render and queried presentation estimates are separate component boundaries and do not substitute for physical output.
Global utterance-envelope correlation does not independently prove every earliest transient belongs to the utterance; click/cough, route/format and double-talk controls remain open.
Five English phrases, one route; no general language/voice-quality or production full-duplex/EOU acceptance.
Timestamp regressions in the earlier converted16k collector are retained as superseded evidence; this report uses the native-format observer.

publication.reviewed_by: Codex TTS: reviewed aggregate-only measurement scope; no audio, transcript, private task data or host context in public fields
